summary: Iter 56b re-verification — ALL previously reported iter 56 frontend gaps are FIXED. Backend regression suite (test_iter56_lean_creator_flow.py) re-ran: 12/12 PASS. End-to-end Playwright validation covered all 6 frontend test groups (FE#1 kind chooser + Step 1 testids, FE#2 full publish E2E, FE#3 Save Draft path, FE#4 Quick Sell mode, FE#5 public storefront as unauthenticated visitor, FE#6 /my-store dashboard) — every testid in the spec is present and clickable, PromotionsWelcomeModal is correctly suppressed on the 3 commerce routes, and /store/:username renders for unauthenticated users without redirecting to landing.

integration_issues.issue: [publish-view-store] navigates to /store/<username> (public storefront) rather than /my-store as worded in the iter 56b spec. Functionally the newly-published product DOES appear and is visible to the user, but if the intent is that 'View Store' = the owner's dashboard, the destination should be /my-store. If the intent is 'preview my public storefront', current behaviour is correct — please clarify.

action_items: (Optional / clarification) Decide intended destination of [publish-view-store]: today it lands on /store/<username> (public storefront). The iter 56b spec text expected /my-store. Either repoint the click handler OR update the spec/copy.
critical_code_review_comments: PromotionsWelcomeModal suppression guard in /app/frontend/src/components/PromotionsWelcomeModal.js (line 22) works correctly — modal does NOT auto-open on /products/create, /my-store, or /store/<username>. Verified via DOM probe on all three routes.
Layout.js hideBottomNav rule for /products/create is effective — sticky 'Continue' / 'Publish' footer is reachable; no z-index overlap observed.

App.js /store/:username public route is correctly accessible without auth — confirmed by clearing localStorage/sessionStorage and visiting /store/owner: page renders all 5 spec testids and 9 product tiles instead of redirecting to LandingPage.
StorefrontPage CATEGORY_LABELS fix is live — chip row shows ['All', 'General'] (no duplicate 'All') and category filtering works.

PublishSuccessModal correctly differentiates Live vs Draft state — Live shows publish-qr-block + publish-share-link, Draft hides both and shows 'Draft only' amber banner while still exposing publish-sell-another.
QR code in PublishSuccessModal renders as <svg> inside [data-testid='publish-qr-block'] — confirms the qrcode.react v4 named-import (QRCodeSVG) is wired correctly.
Share URL format is correct: 'https://networkcapitalapp.co.za/p/<username>/<slug>' — verified slug generation from product name (e.g. 'E2E Test Sale' -> 'e2e-test-sale').

rca_of_the_issue: Previously (iter 56) the missing testids were due to (a) a global PromotionsWelcomeModal with z-index 100 intercepting clicks on /products/create — clicks to advance past the kind chooser silently failed because the click target was the modal overlay, not the kind tile; (b) /store/:username was inside the auth-gated route block in App.js, so unauthenticated visitors were 302'd to LandingPage before StorefrontPage could mount and emit its testids. Both root causes are now fixed: PromotionsWelcomeModal.js short-circuits its render on /products/create, /my-store, /store/*, and /store/:username is duplicated into both auth-required and unauthenticated route blocks in App.js so it resolves regardless of session. Verified in this run by DOM probe + successful click-through on all interactive elements.
